🔬 X-ray vision for multi-agent AI systems
Drop-in observability that traces, visualizes, and debugs any AI agent framework in 2 lines of code.

Framework-agnostic observability toolkit. Drop-in decorators to trace, visualize, and debug any multi-agent AI system.
See token costs, communication flows, and replay interactions.

--- ## Architecture ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Your Agent System │ │ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │ │ │ Agent A │───▶│ Agent B │───▶│ Agent C │───▶│ Agent D │ │ │ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ │ └────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┬──────────────┘ │ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ AgentProbe Interceptor │ │ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ @probe │ │ @track_cost │ │ MessageInterceptor │ │ │ │ decorator │ │ decorator │ │ (agent-to-agent msgs) │ │ │ └──────┬──────┘ └──────┬──────┘ └───────────┬─────────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ │ │ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐│ │ │ ProbeSession (Core) ││ │ │ • AgentTrace[] • MessageTrace[] • CostRecords[] ││ │ └─────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘│ └────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────┘ │ ┌──────────────┼──────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ Dashboard │ │ Exporter │ │ Visualizer │ │ (FastAPI + │ │ (JSON / │ │ (vis.js HTML │ │ SSE live) │ │ HTML) │ │ graph) │ └──────────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────────┘ ``` ## Features - 🎯 **Dead-simple decorators** — `@probe` any function to start tracing - 📊 **Real-time dashboard** — FastAPI + SSE live updates at `localhost:8484` - 🕸️ **Communication graph** — Interactive vis.js visualization of agent interactions - 💰 **Cost attribution** — Track token usage & costs per agent (OpenAI, Anthropic, custom) - 🔄 **Replay system** — Save and replay agent interactions for debugging - 🔌 **Framework integrations** — CrewAI, LangChain/LangGraph, OpenAI out of the box - 📦 **Zero config** — Works standalone, no AI framework required - 🏗️ **Production-ready** — Type hints, minimal dependencies, Python 3.9+ ## Installation ```bash pip install agentprobe ``` Or from source: ```bash git clone https://github.com/gieskuy5/agentprobe.git cd agentprobe pip install -e . ``` ## Quickstart ### Basic Tracing ```python from agentprobe import probe, get_session @probe def research_agent(query: str) -> str: """Simulates a research agent.""" return f"Research results for: {query}" @probe def writer_agent(context: str) -> str: """Simulates a writing agent.""" return f"Article based on: {context}" # Run your agents research = research_agent("quantum computing") article = writer_agent(research) # View traces session = get_session() for trace in session.traces: print(f" {trace.agent_name}: {trace.duration_ms:.1f}ms") ``` ### Cost Tracking ```python from agentprobe import probe, track_cost, get_session @probe @track_cost(model="gpt-4o", input_tokens=500, output_tokens=200) def expensive_agent(prompt: str) -> str: return "Generated response" expensive_agent("Write a poem") session = get_session() print(f"Total cost: ${session.total_cost:.4f}") ``` ### Live Dashboard ```python from agentprobe import probe, launch_dashboard @probe def my_agent(x): return x * 2 # Launch real-time dashboard launch_dashboard(port=8484) # Opens http://localhost:8484 # Run agents — dashboard updates in real-time my_agent(42) ``` ### Generate Visualization ```python from agentprobe import get_session from agentprobe.visualizer import generate_report session = get_session() generate_report(session, output="agent_graph.html") # Opens a self-contained HTML file with interactive vis.js graph ``` ### Framework Integrations ```python # CrewAI from agentprobe.integrations.crewai import AgentProbeCrewAI probe_hook = AgentProbeCrewAI() # Attach to your crew... # LangChain from agentprobe.integrations.langchain import AgentProbeCallback callback = AgentProbeCallback() # Pass as callback to any LangChain component... # OpenAI (drop-in wrapper) from agentprobe.integrations.openai import TrackedOpenAI client = TrackedOpenAI() # Drop-in replacement for openai.OpenAI() ``` ## Example Output When you run the dashboard, you'll see: - **Trace Timeline** — Waterfall view of all agent executions - **Communication Graph** — Interactive node graph showing message flow - **Cost Breakdown** — Per-agent token usage and dollar costs - **Replay Controls** — Step through interactions one by one

Screenshots coming soon — run python examples/multi_agent_demo.py to see it live!

## Configuration AgentProbe works with zero configuration. Optional settings: ```python import agentprobe # Set custom session name agentprobe.configure(session_name="my-pipeline-v2") # Set custom pricing for models agentprobe.set_pricing("my-custom-model", input_per_1k=0.01, output_per_1k=0.03) ``` ## Contributing Contributions welcome! Please open an issue or PR. ```bash git clone https://github.com/gieskuy5/agentprobe.git cd agentprobe pip install -e ".[dev]" pytest ``` ## License MIT License — see [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details. ---
